paper_name: Strategic Performance Management and Business Valuation
author: Rahul kp
title: Economic Value
simple_words: EVA tells whether profit is enough to pay everyone who gave money, including shareholders.

definitions.meaning: Net operating profit after tax minus the ==capital charge==. It is the surplus left after paying the cost of all capital used.
WACC multiplied by capital employed. It includes a cost for equity, which normal accounting profit ignores.

key_points: EVA > 0 means value is created; EVA < 0 means value is destroyed
Accounting profit ignores the ==cost of equity==; EVA charges it
!!Use NOPAT (after tax, before interest)!! as the profit figure
Used for divisional performance and manager bonus linking

formulas.name: Economic Value Added
formulas.legend: NOPAT = net operating profit after tax; WACC = weighted average cost of capital; CE = capital employed

formulas.name: NOPAT
formulas.legend: EBIT = operating profit before interest and tax; t = tax rate

formulas.name: WACC
formulas.legend: Ke = cost of equity; Kd = pre-tax cost of debt; We, Wd = proportions of equity and debt in capital

insight.text: A firm can show accounting profit and still have negative EVA if profit is below the capital charge.

memory_trick.explanation: Capital is a rented shop: NOPAT is your earning, WACC × CE is the rent. What remains after paying rent is EVA.

exam_tip: Check the question for which capital base is given, then use it as given. Write the capital charge line separately for step marks.

doubt.question: Why is interest not deducted in NOPAT?
doubt.answer: Interest is already covered in the capital charge through WACC. Deducting it in NOPAT too would charge debt twice.

mistakes.wrong: Using profit after interest as NOPAT
mistakes.right: Use EBIT × (1 − t); interest is covered by the capital charge in WACC.

mistakes.wrong: Using pre-tax cost of debt in WACC
mistakes.right: Use Kd × (1 − t) because interest gives a tax shield.

mistakes.wrong: Ignoring cost of equity in the capital charge
mistakes.right: Include Ke with equity weight in WACC; equity has a cost.

mistakes.wrong: Saying positive accounting profit means positive EVA
mistakes.right: EVA is positive only if NOPAT exceeds WACC × capital employed.

reviewer_note: Capital employed definition varies (book values, adjustments); the note says use the base given in the question.
check_notes: Writer: Capital employed definition varies (book values, adjustments); the note says use the base given in the question.
